Good to know

Questions,
answered.

Still need a little more clarity? Start a WhatsApp conversation and our team can discuss the specifics of your shipment.

We support documents, parcels, personal baggage, household items, eligible food items, gifts, non-commercial items and commercial shipments. Each shipment is subject to destination and carrier requirements.

Medicines are accepted only if allowed under applicable rules and with required approval. Please share details with our team before sending.

The listed rates are reference USA DDP rates by weight slab. Final pricing may vary depending on shipment details, destination, customs requirements and current pricing.

Use the quote form or WhatsApp button. Your details will open in WhatsApp as a pre-filled message for the team to review.

gap: 13px; } .service-card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid rgb(226, 231, 236); min-height: 212px; padding: 24px; position: relative; transition: transform .35s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s; overflow: hidden; } .service-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: auto 0px 0px; height: 3px; background: var(--red); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .4s var(--ease); } .service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-7px); box-shadow: rgba(7, 31, 65, 0.08) 0px 20px 38px; border-color: rgb(207, 216, 226); } .service-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .service-icon { width: 41px; height: 41px; background: rgb(237, 243, 250); color: var(--navy-2); display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 2px; } .service-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .service-index { position: absolute; right: 22px; top: 25px; color: rgb(184, 194, 206); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; } .service-card h3 { font: 700 17px / 1.15 Outfit; margin: 28px 0px 8px; color: var(--navy); } .service-card p { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; color: rgb(122, 135, 150); max-width: 170px; } .service-arrow { position: absolute; bottom: 22px; right: 22px; color: var(--red); width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform .3s var(--ease); } .service-card:hover .service-arrow { transform: translate(4px, -4px); } .coverage-section { background: var(--navy); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 120px 0px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .coverage-section::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -180px; top: -180px; width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(227, 52, 53, 0.16), transparent 65%); pointer-events: none; } .coverage-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr; gap: 90px; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .coverage-copy h2 { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); } .coverage-copy > p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8; color: rgb(170, 185, 201); max-width: 420px; margin: 25px 0px 30px; } .destination-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 16px 10px; margin: 30px 0px 36px; } .destination-list span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .destination-list svg { color: rgb(240, 124, 124); width: 15px; height: 15px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .map-card { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1.4 / 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 3px; } .map-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: rgba(7, 31, 65, 0.48); z-index: 1; } .map-card img { width: 100%; height: 118%; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.6); will-change: transform; } .map-caption { position: absolute; z-index: 2; bottom: 26px; left: 27px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .map-caption svg { color: rgb(255, 120, 120); width: 19px; height: 19px; } .map-caption strong { font: 600 24px Outfit; display: block; } .map-caption small { display: block; color: rgb(193, 204, 216); font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px; } .route-section { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 96px 0px; } .route-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr; gap: 80px; align-items: center; } .route-inner > p, .route-copy { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8; margin-top:
